steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the required starting screen.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab where purchasable requisitions are shown.

args.goal: find a purchase requisition row whose Item Type is BOQ, open it, verify that its bill of quantities shows sections and items and that it can only be selected as one BOQ PR at a time, then start purchasing it and stop on the resulting BOQ project create screen

steps.note: Identify the BOQ-specific PR and perform the on-screen inspection and transition that the catalog has no dedicated step for.
Confirm the BOQ PR opened a project creation screen rather than a normal PR or event list.
Verify the resulting create screen has the BOQ-specific sheet upload control.
